question: Under what condition is the capacity attributed to an angered agent to disturb the totality of realms including both moving and unmoving things?
premises: An angered state is posited as a condition here.
The addressee is addressed as goddess with agency.
The object is the three worlds together with moving and unmoving things.
inference: Agitation in that agent is presented as capable of shaking the whole triple world.
uncertainties: Whether 'cālayet' is literal or figurative remains undecidable from this verse alone.
plain_english: But when angered, O goddess, one may shake the three worlds together with all that moves and does not move.
